title: Spirits Over The Horizon [Album]
description: Spirits Over The Horizon, also known as SOTH, was an album said to have been worked on between April and June 2021, which was made public around September 2021. It was said to have been split up into three different versions for April, May, and June, being separate albums in themselves. All of this turned out to be a lie; there is no proof of Spirits Over The Horizon ever existing and every seller besides Pacifist has stated that their files just say Donda. The "April Version" of SOTH was actually 88 Keys's work folder, which contained mainly tracks from December-January as well as other songs from up to June 2021 and from Yandhi. The May version of the album turned out to be the Dem Jointz's project, not actually an album Kanye was working on. The June version of SOTH was just June Donda. Only in July of 2022 did sellers admit that they had no proof of Spirits Over The Horizon existing.

title: Ty Dolla $ign - $ign Language [V1]
description: Original version of the "VULTURES" outro from when it was a solo Ty song, intended to be the intro and title track for his album $ign Language 2, likely before Juicy J got involved. Has no drums, a different pitch, a slower tempo, an alternate chopping of the sample, and some slightly different lines. The verse and sample chop were later lifted from this song and the lines "way out in Saudi" and "free TC, Melly, and Thug" were punched-in for "VULTURES". According to Ty, he recorded the song in 2022 while swimming in a pool in Bali. Played by Ty on a Twitch stream September 2nd, 2025.
